'''Mantual''' is a tribesman from [[Seanchan]]. He is into his middle years and stocky with dark brown eyes and a narrow beard.

==Activities==
He is from [[Pujili]] and is [[Gamel Loune]]'s manservant. 
He wears a pair of long knifes at his belt and his hands show a knifeman's calluses.

He attached himself years ago to Gamel Loune and has been over-protective of him since then. Loune is sure that Mantual would stay even if he stopped paying him. [[Karede]] senses him to be close kin to [[Ajimbura]], in spirit, but not in blood.

Mantual serves the Banner-General's ''[[kaf]]'', all the while eyeing Karede.
